info.name: GRYSOSTA API
info.description:
REST API for the GRYSOSTA VIP landing page, referral system and admin panel.

**Start here:**
1. Set `serverUrl` (e.g. http://localhost:4000 or your live API), `adminEmail` and `adminPassword` in the collection *Variables* tab.
2. Run **3. Auth › Login** — the token is saved automatically.
3. Run **1. Public › Signup — join referral program** to get a `referralCode`.
4. Run **A5 › List** and **A6 › List** to fill `memberId` and `referrerId`.

Requests save IDs/tokens into collection variables, so the folders can be run top to bottom (Collection Runner).

request.description: Server + database status.

item.name: 3. Auth (A1)
item.description: Run **Login** first. The token is saved to `token` and used by every admin request (collection auth = Bearer {{token}}).

request.description: Returns `token`. If 2-step login is enabled you get `{ twoFactorRequired: true, challengeToken }` → use *Verify 2-step code*. 5 wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes (423).
Only when 2-step login is enabled. `code` = 6 digits from the authenticator app.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.token) pm.collectionVariables.set("token", j.data.token);

request.description: Signs out the other sessions.
Returns `secret` and `otpauthUrl` (show as QR code in the authenticator app).
Code from the authenticator app.

item.name: 1. Public (landing page)
item.description: Endpoints the public website calls. No admin login needed.

request.description: Landing page data: prices, site mode, commission %, texts, FAQ, policy pages, images, active announcements. Book links + general VIP code only appear in launch mode.
Creates the unique code (GSTA + name + 2 digits) and link. Saves `referralCode` and `referrerEmail` for the next requests.

Call on every page open. Counts the daily visitor. With a valid `ref` it records a referral visit (once per visitor per day) and sets the 60-day `gsta_ref` cookie. Returns the referrer's first name for the welcome bar.
Returns `{ code, firstName }`. 404 for invalid, paused or blocked codes.

SRS 6.1. Response `kind`: `vip`, `referrer`, `upgraded` or `already`. Max 5 signups per IP per hour (all signup requests count — if you get 429, wait or restart the API in development). `botToken` = Cloudflare Turnstile token (ignored when TURNSTILE_SECRET is empty).
Shows the server-side validation messages for every field.
Returns the Etsy link for the language and the code to show (referrer's code or the general VIP code). Counts the click.

item.name: 2. My Referrals (referrer self-check)
item.description: SRS 6.7. Run **1. Public › Signup — join referral program** first (it saves `referrerEmail`). Request a magic link → Verify → the other requests use `referrerToken` automatically. In production, paste the `token=` value from the email link into the `magicToken` variable.

request.description: Always 200 (no account enumeration). Max 5 per hour. In local development without BREVO_API_KEY the response also contains `devMagicToken`, saved to `magicToken` automatically; in production copy the token from the email link.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.devMagicToken) pm.collectionVariables.set("magicToken", j.data.devMagicToken);

request.description: Single use, 30 minutes. Returns a 24-hour referrer session token (saved to `referrerToken`).

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.token) pm.collectionVariables.set("referrerToken", j.data.token);

request.description: Code, link, visits, signups, clicks, sales, commission earned / paid / unpaid.

item.name: 4. Admin panel
item.description: All requests use Bearer {{token}} (run Login first).

request.description: Cards, signups per day (30 days), EN vs ES, top 10 referrers, last 10 signups, site mode.

item.name: Switch to Launch mode + links & prices

request.description: `autoVipPrice: true` calculates the VIP price from the discount %. `launchDate` (ISO) shows a countdown.
Includes `effectiveStatus` (draft / published / scheduled / expired), `hasEn`, `hasEs`.
Rich text is sanitized. `status: published` with a future `startsAt` becomes `scheduled`.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("announcementId", j.data._id);

request.description: Send all ids in the new order.
Choose a WebP/JPG/PNG file in the `image` field. Returns a URL to put in `imageUrl`.
`audience`: all · en · es · referrers. Returns an email log (202); track progress in *A10 › Email log by id*.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("emailLogId", j.data._id);

request.description: Enable the query params you need. `referredBy` = referrer id, `any` or `none`.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data[0] && j.data[0]._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("memberId", j.data[0] && j.data[0]._id);

request.description: Use *Send and Download*. `format=xlsx` for Excel.
One-click unsubscribe. `unsubscribeToken` is filled by *Get member* above (from `unsubscribeLink`). This is the page the email footer links to.
400 if the member is already a referrer.
`action`: unsubscribe · delete · export (with `format`: csv/xlsx).
Permanent. Their referral code is retired and never reused.
Sort by any column: name, code, status, etsy, visits, signups, clicks, sales, earned, paid, unpaid, ready (prefix `-` for descending).

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data[0] && j.data[0].id) pm.collectionVariables.set("referrerId", j.data[0] && j.data[0].id);

request.description: Must stay unique (409 if taken). Resets the Etsy flag.
Sorted by most signups first.

item.name: A8 Sales Import
item.description: Upload → (mapping) → confirm. Pick your Etsy Orders CSV in the `file` field of *Upload & preview*.

request.description: Choose the CSV file (max 10 MB). Returns `draftId`, the suggested column mapping and a summary: rows found, known codes, unknown codes, duplicates, total commission.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.draftId) pm.collectionVariables.set("draftId", j.data.draftId);

request.description: `assignments` for unknown codes: a referrer id, `"skip"`, or `null` (save without referrer).
`amount` = what the buyer paid (after discount).

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data[0] && j.data[0]._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("saleId", j.data[0] && j.data[0]._id);

request.description: Commission → Cancelled. If already paid it becomes a negative balance for the next payout.
Pending → Approved after the holding period (also runs daily).
Sales count, sales total, commission, paid, unpaid, ready to pay. `meta.totals` has pending / approved / paid.
Approved commissions (oldest first) up to the amount become Paid. Method: PayPal · Zelle · Cash App · Bank · Other.
Use *Send and Download*.
Placeholders: {first_name} {code} {referral_link} {book_link} {price} {vip_price} {commission_percent} {unsubscribe_link}. `[Button text]` on its own line = red button.
Sends to the logged-in admin (or `to`).
Batches within the Brevo daily limit.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("emailLogId", j.data._id);

request.description: Keys: heroHeadline, heroSub, heroText, priceNote, referralText, footerTagline, disclaimer.
Change `hero` in the URL to cover, retirement or og.
Commission % changes apply only to sales imported afterwards. Site mode is changed in A3.
Datasets: members · referrers · sales · commissions · payouts · activity. Use *Send and Download*.
